question: 'Mangifera Indica' is the scientific name of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mango**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scientific name

 
 
• This system was given by Carolus Linnaeus.
 
• Each name has two components – the Generic name and the specific epithet.
 
• This system of providing a name with two components is called Binomial nomenclature.
 
• The scientific name of mango is written as Mangifera indica.
 
• In this name, Mangifera represents the genus while indica is a particular species.
